predicted.recorded_utc_note: Written to disk and committed BEFORE the first fold of this row, and digested into every result.json by capture.py. Nothing below was edited after a measurement.
predicted.model_cycles_saved_note: Every size and every clock runs the identical 200-step, 3-recycle, 1-sample, seed-0 configuration on the committed fixture with its 35-row A3M. No transform, flag, trace or kernel changes. This row prices nothing and ships nothing, so the predicted model-cycle saving is exactly zero and any non-zero reading would be a defect in the harness, not a win.

anchor.t_1350_sources: c10-bare-baseline pooled median 14.881 s over 16 folds, min 14.813, max 14.972; c10-fixed-cost cell median 14.9306 s
anchor.if_it_fails: STOP, report the discrepancy, quote nothing else from the session

finding.claim: the device's clock-scaled work really does grow sublinearly with the target, so a large size-independent term exists and is worth attacking
finding.leg_shape: p_work flat and below about 1.0 on all three legs

artifact.claim: 298 tokens pad to 320 and spread over 110 cores, so every core holds its minimum tile and the op costs what a larger one costs; that inflates W(298), shrinks the 298->512 ratio and manufactures the sublinear exponent. Above 512 the under-fill is gone and the exponent returns to the target's own growth

fixed_term_prediction.F_model_s: F(N) ~ 0.0095*N - 0.881, the straight line through c10-fixed-cost's F(298) = 1.950 s and F(512) = 3.983 s
fixed_term_prediction.note: F is predicted to keep growing with the target because featurization and CIF writing scale with it. A flat F above 512 aa would itself be a finding and is not what this row is testing.

discriminating_power.separation: the two hypotheses are 0.7 apart on the 512->768 leg against an expected se_p of about 0.03, roughly 23 sigma; even a se_p of 0.15 separates them at over 4 sigma from their midpoint of 1.35
discriminating_power.quotability_bar: a leg whose se_p_work exceeds 0.15 is not quoted
discriminating_power.folds: 5 per cell, 2 clocks, 4 sizes, 40 accepted folds

refutation_of_this_prediction: p_work at or above 1.7 on the 512->768 leg: ARTIFACT, the size-independent term is withdrawn. A full pass
p_work rising monotonically and significantly across the three legs: the same verdict read off the shape
any fitted W at or below 0 Mcycles: the two-clock separation is broken, no exponent quoted
768 aa OOMs or crashes: fall back to 640 as the top of the ladder, top leg reported as unmeasured
the above-cap fused SDPA route counter non-zero at any size: the code path is not uniform, no exponent quoted
predicted.parity_prediction: Same-seed byte-identical CIF within every size, across both clock arms and all repetitions, as c10-bare-baseline and c10-fixed-cost both observed on this fixture family. Predicted structural deviation 0 A. No accuracy claim against upstream is owed or made.
